conflictToResolveFirst.recordEffect: The existing broad route is legally overbroad. Never-charged matters must use a distinct ORS 137.225(1)(c) Option 3 configuration; acquittals must use a distinct ORS 137.225(1)(d) Option 2 configuration; ordinary dismissals must use a separate ORS 137.225(1)(d) Option 2 configuration. The treatments may share one packet family only if each has a distinct governed configuration; they may not resolve to one generic or null packet configuration.
conflictToResolveFirst.captainOwns: The conflict is between the retriage's cited aggregate decision and a newer counsel record. Resolving which controls is a Captain decision, not a worker's, and it is an input to this lane rather than part of it.

detail.whyTheWholeQueueIsResidual: A per-row stop condition was written as if it stopped the lane. The rewritten assignment stops the ROW and continues, so one conflicted row cannot hold thirty-six others.
